verdicts.reason: A: the SUNSET SALE ribbon collides with the SOLSTICE logo and the start of the headline. The legal text sits between the headline and the body copy, which breaks the reading order. The product can is gone. The CTA is small and crammed in with the badges, and a clipped image placeholder at the bottom right collides with them. B: the two-column banner keeps the headline and a prominent CTA and gives a clear hierarchy, but the can is tiny and nearly touches the sale ribbon. The body and legal text are close to illegible at this size, and the left column has awkward empty gaps.
